about.title: From Idea to Production
about.bio1: I'm a Computer Science graduate from Kasetsart University, Kamphaeng Saen Campus, with hands-on software engineering experience gained through cooperative education. I enjoy working across the stack — designing intuitive front-ends, building dependable APIs, and shipping mobile apps that people actually use.
about.bio2: My recent work spans a real-time face attendance system, a mobile transcript checker, and a machine-learning stock price prediction model — each one an exercise in turning a practical problem into a working product.
